        let product = Self::multiply_high(Self::SEG_SLOPES[seg], (key as u64).wrapping_sub(Self::SEG_KEYS[seg] as u64));
        let intercept = Self::SEG_INTERCEPTS[seg] as i32;
        let max_product = 5 - intercept;
        (if product > max_product as u64 { max_product } else { product as i32 }) + intercept
    }

    fn get_segment_pos(key: i32) -> i32 {
        let mut seg: usize = 0;
        let mut seg_hi: usize = 1;
        while seg < seg_hi {
            let mid: usize = seg + ((seg_hi - seg) >> 1);
            if Self::SEG_KEYS[mid + 1] <= key {
                seg = mid + 1;
            } else {
                seg_hi = mid;

        let mut pos: i32 = Self::evaluate_segment(seg, key);
        let next_intercept: i32 = Self::SEG_INTERCEPTS[seg + 1] as i32;
        if pos > next_intercept { pos = next_intercept; }

        let lo_raw: i32 = pos - 65;
        let mut lo: usize = if lo_raw < 0 { 0 } else { lo_raw as usize };
        let mut hi: usize = (pos as usize) + 67;
        if hi > 5 { hi = 5; }

        while lo < hi {
            let mid: usize = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);
